{"hypotheses":[{"nl":"Return the least frequent color in the grid as a 1x1 output; ties use the smallest value.","code":"def transform(grid):
 from collections import Counter
 c=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r); m=min(c.values()); return [[min(x for x,n in c.items() if n==m)]]"},{"nl":"Return the color occupying the fewest cells, with ties resolved by first appearance.","code":"def transform(grid):
 from collections import Counter
 c=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r); return [[min(c,key=lambda x:(c[x], next(i for i,r in enumerate(grid) for j,y in enumerate(r) if y==x), x))]]"},{"nl":"Return the singleton/rare object color: the least common value.","code":"def transform(grid):
 from collections import Counter
 c=Counter(sum(grid,[])); return [[sorted(c,key=lambda x:(c[x],x))[0]]]"},{"nl":"Return the color whose frequency is strictly smallest; choose lowest numeric color on tie.","code":"def transform(grid):
 d={x:sum(x==y for r in grid for y in r) for x in set(sum(grid,[]))}; return [[sorted(d,key=lambda x:(d[x],x))[0]]]"},{"nl":"Count each distinct color and output the least frequent one.","code":"def transform(grid):
 vals=[x for r in grid for x in r]; return [[min(set(vals),key=lambda x:(vals.count(x),x))]]"},{"nl":"Output the rarest symbol in row-major grid order, breaking frequency ties by earliest occurrence.","code":"def transform(grid):
 vals=sum(grid,[]); from collections import Counter
 c=Counter(vals); return [[next(x for x in vals if c[x]==min(c.values()))]]"},{"nl":"Output the color with minimum global area, breaking ties by numeric order.","code":"def transform(grid):
 from collections import Counter
 c=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row); return [[sorted(c,key=lambda v:(c[v],v))[0]]]"},{"nl":"The output is the minority color among all colors in the input.","code":"def transform(grid):
 from collections import Counter
 c=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row); return [[sorted(c.items(),key=lambda p:(p[1],p[0]))[0][0]]]"},{"nl":"Return the least frequent cell value, using the first encountered value to resolve ties.","code":"def transform(grid):
 from collections import Counter
 a=[v for row in grid for v in row]; c=Counter(a); return [[min(c,key=lambda v:(c[v],a.index(v)))]]"},{"nl":"Select the color with smallest population and place it in a singleton grid.","code":"def transform(grid):
 from collections import Counter
 c=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row); k=min(c,key=c.get); return [[k]]"}]}
